briefs.label: Friday 20 November 2026

items.title: ISSB meets in Frankfurt on SASB enhancements and workforce disclosures
items.summary: The 18 to 19 November meeting also covered feedback on the taxonomy update for the GHG emissions amendments. Workforce disclosure is the next big ISSB topic after climate.
items.why: After climate (IFRS S2), workforce disclosure looks like the next ISSB standard-setting area, and SASB enhancements feed straight into how IFRS S1 is applied in practice.

items.title: PCAOB splits enforcement into five specialised units
items.summary: A new Global Network Firm unit focuses on the largest firms ahead of QC 1000 taking effect on 15 December, so the Big Four now face a dedicated enforcement team.
items.why: A dedicated unit for the largest network firms signals tougher scrutiny of Big Four audit quality just as the new quality control standard QC 1000 starts.

items.title: PCAOB weighs 2026 to 2030 strategic plan and FY2027 budget
items.summary: The 19 November open meeting also considered a permanent inspection program for broker-dealer auditors, replacing the interim one in place since 2011. Outcomes are not yet published.
items.why: The strategic plan and budget set PCAOB inspection and enforcement priorities for the next five years.

items.title: Dow drops 1,100 points as the Fed signals more hikes
items.summary: The Dow fell 2.19% to 49,097 and the S&P 500 lost 2.0% to about 7,177, its sixth straight losing session. The 10-year Treasury yield sits at 5.07%.
items.why: Higher US yields and a hawkish Fed tighten global financial conditions, which feeds into emerging market currencies and equities, Indonesia included.

items.title: Traders price a 50 bp Fed hike in December
items.summary: That reverses last year's rate-cut story and puts pressure on emerging market currencies, including the rupiah.
items.why: A bigger Fed hike widens the US rate advantage, adding pressure on the rupiah and on Bank Indonesia to keep rates high.

items.title: Anthropic lists on Nasdaq after a record US$81.3bn IPO
items.summary: Shares opened at US$111.51 against an US$83 offer price and settled near US$98.
items.why: A record-sized listing is a useful live case for IPO pricing and first-day returns.

items.title: ATO extends GIC remission offer to 30 June 2027
items.summary: Small businesses with turnover under $50m also get a four-year amendment window from 2024-25.
items.why: Relevant for small business clients and sole traders managing ATO debts and amendment periods.

items.title: High Court upholds Part IVA in Merchant and rejects Uber payroll tax appeal
items.summary: Uber lost 6 to 1 on about $81.5m in NSW payroll tax. Both cases are useful for tax dispute study.
items.why: Merchant confirms the reach of Part IVA, the general anti-avoidance rule, and Uber shows how payroll tax disputes over worker classification are being decided at the top court.

items.title: EY survey: 73% of TP leaders struggle to get transfer pricing data
items.summary: 67% still rely on spreadsheets, and 58% rate avoiding disputes and penalties as very important.
items.why: Shows the practical data gap behind transfer pricing compliance, which is where many disputes start.

items.title: Bank Indonesia lifts the BI-Rate 25 bps to 6.00%
items.summary: Its third hike this cycle after May and June. The deposit facility is now 5.25% and the lending facility 6.75%, aimed at stabilising the rupiah.
items.why: Higher BI rates raise borrowing costs in Indonesia and are aimed squarely at defending the rupiah.

items.title: PP 41/2026 sets tax rules for Danantara and SOE holdings
items.summary: 0% final income tax on share transfers by grant, book-value transfers in restructurings, and special TP documentation treatment until tax year 2029.
items.why: A combined case of restructuring tax neutrality and TP documentation relief for state-owned groups.

items.title: Danantara can be excluded as a Pillar Two ultimate parent
items.summary: Under Article 35 of PP 41/2026, Danantara and two holdings would not file the GloBE Information Return under PMK 136/2024. Their directly owned subsidiaries file instead.
items.why: Shows how Indonesia applies the Pillar Two GloBE rules (PMK 136/2024) to sovereign-owned groups and who carries the filing duty.

items.title: Tax revenue to October hits IDR1,796.8tn, 76.2% of target
items.summary: Up 23.9% year on year. DJP is pushing audits and supervision to close the gap by year end.
items.why: Indicates how close the government is to its 2026 revenue target and why DJP enforcement is stepping up before year end.

items.title: DPR passes Asset Forfeiture Bill with tax crimes dropped
items.summary: Separately, the kurs pajak for 18 to 24 November is Rp18,155 per US$, weaker by Rp20.
items.why: Tax crimes stay under the tax procedure law, and the kurs pajak is the rate used to convert foreign-currency transactions for tax.

worth.title: PP 41/2026 and Danantara
worth.text: A live case study that combines Pillar Two UPE rules, transfer pricing documentation relief and tax-neutral restructuring for state-owned groups.
